title: The Creation of Adam
notes: A hadith in Tirmidhi says Adam was made from a handful taken from all of the earth, so his children came in its colours: red, white, black and every shade between.
In Sahih Muslim, Iblis is described circling the clay form before it was given life, trying to understand what it was.
art: Adam is shown only as a silhouette of light within the clay, never in detail.
imagePrompt: Clay of many colours (red, white, black, ochre) gathering from every direction into the outline of a standing human figure, seen only as a silhouette of light within the clay; rings of angelic light encircling it; just outside the rings, a dark figure wrapped in a faint smouldering glow with arms crossed, watching with suspicion; Arabic words orbiting the luminous silhouette.

beats.say: Allah gathered clay from every land of the earth: red and white, black and every shade between.
The soil drew together into the shape of a man, while Iblis, a jinn, circled and watched.

verse.en: I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.

beats.say: A breath of light flowed into the form, and it glowed from within.

verse.en: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration.

beats.say: Adam was taught the names of all things, names the angels could not give.

verse.en: And He taught Adam the names - all of them.
